_comment: Deluxe Paints showcase — one wall spanning HSE + security: real production-floor FIRE, ATM vandalism/theft (crowbar on the ATM), a concealment grab-and-run, and a PANIC-running crowd. Fire/panic use the manufacturing_hse_v1 rules; the theft cameras use the retail all_threats_video_v1 rules (VideoMAE + concealment). Every alert is TrueSight-verified.
name: Deluxe Paints — HSE + Security

cameras.scene_description: Paint manufacturing/warehouse floor where visible flame, smoke or haze indicates a fire hazard.
Forecourt/ATM area where someone tampering with or breaking into the ATM or a vehicle is a theft.
Retail display area where a person concealing merchandise or grabbing and running is theft.
Factory aisle where people normally walk calmly; running may indicate panic, an accident, or evacuation.
